title: Goldman Sachs to Acquire ETF Provider Neos in $2.3B Deal
title_zh: 高盛将以 2.3B 美元的交易收购 ETF 提供商 Neos
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Neil Sipes joins Scarlet Fu and James Seyffart on "ETF IQ." Goldman Sachs will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager's reach in the actively managed ETF market.

title: The Goldman Sachs Group (GS)’s CEO Says He Has “a Deep Belief” in NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA). Reuters Compares the Deal to Auto Loans
title_zh: 高盛集团 (GS) 首席执行官表示他对 NVIDIA 公司 (NVDA) 怀有“深深的信念”。路透社将该交易与汽车贷款进行比较
summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) CEO David Solomon joined CEO of NVIDIA Jensen Huang and other Wall Street chiefs on CNBC’s Closing Bell Overtime this week to detail the $500 billion AI infrastructure financing plan.
summary_zh: 高盛集团 (NYSE:GS) 首席执行官大卫·所罗门 (David Solomon) 与 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 以及其他华尔街高管本周在 CNBC 的收盘钟加时节目中详细介绍了 5000 亿美元的人工智能基础设施融资计划。

title: Workday Stock Is Downgraded After Buyout Report as Growth Expectations Are ‘Too Optimistic’
title_zh: 由于增长预期“过于乐观”，收购报告后 Workday 股票评级被下调
summary: Wall Street is hitting the pause button on Workday after shares rose sharply higher on report of a possible private-equity takeover.
summary_zh: 在有关可能的私募股权收购的报道导致股价大幅上涨后，华尔街在工作日按下了暂停按钮。
